properties.name: documentRef
properties.description: One or more document template ids, comma-separated. A task can produce several deliverables; see utils/documentRefs.ts for why this is a delimited attribute rather than isMany or child elements.

properties.name: signatureRef
properties.description: The document template a signature task signs. Bundled at deploy like a documentRef, but names exactly one template.

properties.name: phases
properties.description: The phases this process declares for RBA's caseworker stepper: code:Name pairs separated by ';' (#242). Absent means Awb phases (ronl:awbPhase markers) or no stepper.

properties.name: phaseLabel
properties.description: Prefix for a phase reference in the stepper. Absent means 'Fase'.

properties.name: phase
properties.description: Code of the declared phase this node starts. Unmarked nodes inherit; see utils/phases/assignPhases.ts.

properties.name: awbPhase
properties.description: Awb phase this node starts, for processes that declare no phases of their own.
